tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Definitions of the levels of evidence, the statuses, the freshness limits and the confidence score that come with every Vuntum value, as written on the methodology page. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Full-text search over the published robot sheets: accents ignored, word starts, synonyms, close spelling, ranked by relevance. `matchQuality` says whether all the words, some of them or a close spelling were found. `locale: "fr"` for French texts and addresses.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: The site search: robots, manufacturers and articles (full article text included). Can be filtered by type. Returns the type, title, summary and address of each result. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: A published article (text, date, sources) from its URL identifier (the `slug` of an article result, in the same language). `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Full sheet of a published robot: summary, form, use, utilities, characteristics, prices, availability, sources. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: get_robot_claims
tools.description: All the validated claims of a robot, with evidence, source and quote. `locale: "fr"` for French values.

tools.name: get_robot_sources
tools.description: Sources behind the published claims of a robot. `locale: "fr"` for French source names.

tools.name: get_robot_prices
tools.description: Observed prices by market, price type and date. `locale: "fr"` for French notes.

tools.name: get_robot_availability
tools.description: Availability state by market, with observation date. `locale: "fr"` for French notes.

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Comparison of 2 to 4 published robots on the columns of the Vuntum comparison. Each row says whether the values differ (`differs`); `differingPredicates` lists what sets the robots apart, `missingByRobot` what is not disclosed. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: find_home_robots
tools.description: Robots with a validated claim that they handle household tasks. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: find_robots_by_utility
tools.description: Published robots that have a given utility (the keys are the site's French slugs): menage, jardin, cuisine, compagnie, education, loisirs, aide-personne, medical, reeducation, recherche, logistique, livraison, accueil, nettoyage-pro, inspection, construction, agriculture, industrie, exploration, tel

tools.name: find_robots_by_capability
tools.description: Published robots with a validated claim behind each requested capability: marcher, courir, escaliers, se-relever, saisir, plier-linge, ranger, navigation, parler. Never inferred from a category: each capability returns the claim, its source and its level of evidence. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: find_programmable_robots
tools.description: Robots with a public SDK, Python API, ROS or MCP, by deterministic criteria. `locale: "fr"` for French.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Public change log: publications, corrections, price changes. `locale: "fr"` for French sentences.

tools.name: search_open_source_projects
tools.description: Open source repositories related to robotics listed by Vuntum. No English description is written for a repository: with `locale: "en"` only the repository's own words are returned.
